title: sync.WaitGroup.Go
short_description: One method that removes the Add/Done bookkeeping, and the class of bug that came with it.
summary: `wg.Add(1)`, `go func() { defer wg.Done(); ... }()` is the most copy-pasted four lines in Go, and it has three well-known ways to go wrong: forgetting `Done`, putting `Add` inside the goroutine, and reusing a `WaitGroup` before `Wait` returns. `wg.Go(f)` does the counting for you, so two of those become impossible to write.
diagram_caption: The counter is incremented before the goroutine starts and decremented by a deferred call you cannot forget.
